QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Sion's Soulmate
QuestInfo.0: Go see Sion at the Tent House to see if Crawls with Balrog is really okay now.
QuestInfo.1: You have to find out if Rius, Sion's soulmate, is okay.\nGo to the western side of the forest and look for #eRius#n.
QuestInfo.2: You found Rius at #m300010200#, carefully studying a Stone Golem.

0.0: Crawls with Balrog is okay now. He really is an amazing child, beating his fever like that. Thank you for helping us.
0.1: Since you're so kind...could I ask for one more favor?

yes.0: My soulmate Rius is exploring the western part of Mossy Tree Forest. He used to contact me every day, but I haven't heard from him in several days. I'm sure he's fine, out there in the dark forest...with all the monsters...but I'm a little nervous. Please find him and see if he's okay.

no.0: I see...you must be quite busy, helping everyone around camp.

1.0: Kao! Long time no see. What bring you to these parts? I thought you liked bumming around the camp! Ha!
1.1: Hmm? Oh, Sion was worried about me, huh? Yeah, I got kinda caught up in my work...

npc.0: I heard he was headed to the western side of Mossy Tree Forest. Please find #eRius#n for me.
